steps.en: Install PaddlePaddle 1.x first, then the Senta package
steps.zh: 先装 PaddlePaddle 1.x，再装 Senta 包

steps.en: Create the predictor and choose a SKEP model and a task
steps.zh: 创建预测器，选一个 SKEP 模型和一个任务

steps.en: Downloads that task's fine-tuned checkpoint, checks its md5, loads it with its tokenizer
steps.zh: 下载该任务的微调权重，校验 md5，连同分词器一起加载

steps.en: Pass in a list of texts (plus aspect terms for aspect-level tasks)
steps.zh: 传入一组文本（评价对象级任务再加上评价对象）

steps.en: Tokenizes each text, runs the SKEP model and returns its sentiment prediction
steps.zh: 逐条分词，跑 SKEP 模型，返回情感预测结果

value.en: Sentence- and aspect-level sentiment from a published SKEP model in a few lines, with no pretraining or fine-tuning of your own
value.zh: 几行代码就用上论文发布的 SKEP 模型做句子级和评价对象级情感分析，不用自己预训练或微调

sources: https://github.com/baidu/Senta#一键化工具 (python -m pip install Senta; PaddlePaddle must be installed first; from senta import Senta; my_senta.init_model(model_class="ernie_1.0_skep_large_ch", task="sentiment_classify", use_cuda=use_cuda); my_senta.predict(texts) / predict(texts, aspects))
https://github.com/baidu/Senta/blob/master/senta/train.py (init_model: download_data(model_file_http_url, md5 url) into model_files, load inference model, build tokenizer)
